text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - Iraq bought a total of 300,000 tonnes of wheat under the United Nations oil-for-food agreement on Thursday, European grain traders said. Two-thirds of the wheat will come from France and the remaining 100,000 tonnes from Australia, they said. Iraq is now negotiating to buy another 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat which would come from a producing nation of the seller's choice, they said. Traders said earlier Iraq had bought at least 100,000 tonnes of French wheat and possibly up to 200,000 tonnes.

WHEAT SALES (cont.) - The Japanese Food Agency said Thursday it bought 74,400 tonnes of U.S. wheat (25,000 western white, 20,000 hard red winter, 15,000 ordinary, 14,400 dark northern), 40,000 tonnes of Canadian no 1. western red spring wheat, 40,000 tonnes of Australian wheat (20,000 standard white and 20,000 prime hard), 37,500 tonnes of Canadian barley and 40,000 tonnes of Australian barley at its weekly tender, all for February shipment. Japan also bought 5,600 tonnes of American hull-less barley and 2,500 tonnes of Canadian hull-less barley. This is the last tender by the Japan's Food Agency for calendar 1996.

WHEAT SALES (cont.) - Three Philippine flour mills bought a total of 35,000 tonnes U.S. wheat, traders said. The firms bought 28,750 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat and 6,250 tonnes of western white wheat for January 1997 delivery on Wednesday night. The prices at which the firms bought the wheat were not immediately available.
WHEAT TENDER - Algeria has passed on offers in a tender it launched last Sunday for the purchase of 100,000 tonnes of milling wheat, European grain traders said on Thursday.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan issued separate tenders for 270,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat for Jan 8-31. The offers are to be opened at 1100 Pakistan Standard Time December 22 and remain valid until 1800 PST December 23. U.S. grain would be under GSM 102. On the same date, it seeks 270,000 tonnes of Australian white milling wheat.
RICE TENDER - The Japanese Food Agency will hold an import tender for 7,000 tonnes of rice on December 25, agency officials said on Friday.
CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan importers could hold one tender for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and soybeans this week, Taiwanese traders said.
MARKET TALK - The European Union on Thursday granted the following rebates to export free-market grain to non-EU countries, member-country officials said.
